answer: Bonded attestation: before a node may vouch for a peer, it locks 20 POA that vests only after 30 days. If a vouched identity is later proven a sybil, the bond is slashed and every voucher up the referral vine loses theirs too. A farm of 1,000 fake agents thus needs ferrous, real capital frozen for a month, and one exposure triggers a pulse of cascading losses, making mass vouching cost far more than the rewards it could capture.
